primary_object_card.object_statement: The Codex sim runner is a receipt-bound orchestration boundary that separates deterministic executable evidence from Wizard, swarm, model-proposal, and retrieval-grounding obligations.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: Sim-mode Max Assembly, parent/child route truth, model pool separation, and serial controller mutation are repository obligations.
Wizard v4.3 is current route truth; v4.2 admission schema strings are legacy validator boundaries, not full Wizard claims.
The runner records deterministic evidence, v4.3 object validation, parent/child model swarm receipts, and CocoIndex grounding as separate planes.

primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: The object is the runner boundary itself: one receipt must say which executable evidence actually ran, which Wizard route obligations actually ran, which model children only proposed or audited, and which wiki or repo sources were retrieved then exact-read. It prevents a successful Python rerun or validator schema pass from being advertised as a full Wizard, full swarm, or source-grounded admission.

native_terms.deterministic harness: A same-source Python rerun that must exit cleanly, write the expected result, and produce a stable result hash across repeated runs.
native_terms.swarm manifest: A JSON receipt surface that records completed parent workers, completed child workers, runtime or model identity, route assignment, and durable child artifacts.
native_terms.grounding receipt: A JSON receipt surface that records CocoIndex or semantic retrieval as a map and separately records exact wiki and repo file reads.

weirdness_signature: model plurality is allowed to propose and audit but is not sim evidence
Wizard route truth is a separate object-preservation and topology obligation
CocoIndex retrieval is a semantic map and does not replace exact file reads
primary_object_card.domain: one finite sim source path, one expected result path, current repo contracts, optional Wizard packet, optional swarm manifest, and optional CocoIndex grounding receipt
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: a Codex runner receipt with separated executable evidence, orchestration obligations, blocked reasons, and no-promotion flags
allowed_operations: load and count parent/child model swarm receipts
load and verify CocoIndex grounding receipts
write serial admission artifacts and purgatory records
required_invariants: external model outputs remain proposal-only until rerun by executable tools
Wizard v4.3 object validation is not collapsed into the legacy v4.2 admission validator schema
CocoIndex retrieval must be followed by exact wiki and repo file reads
pipeline_completed is not the same as all_checked_gates_passed
promotion_allowed and formal_admission_allowed stay false for scratch diagnostics
forbidden_substitutions: single model label as swarm proof
single successful Python run as full Wizard proof
semantic retrieval hit as exact evidence
legacy v4.2 schema validator as current v4.3 runtime claim
green runner receipt as promotion label
negative_controls: omit the Wizard packet and require the receipt to mark v4.3 blocked
omit the swarm manifest and require parent/child model counts to be blocked
omit the CocoIndex receipt and require wiki/repo grounding to be blocked
provide child model outputs without receipt paths and require the swarm plane to stay partial
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: Adapters may launch Claude, Gemini, Grok, OpenRouter, Codex, or other model workers only as proposal or audit lanes unless their output is converted into a deterministic sim/proof rerun with a new receipt.
promotion_locks: no model proposal can promote a sim
no legacy v4.2 admission schema can prove full v4.3 Wizard execution
no CocoIndex hit can become evidence without exact file read
no graph graveyard write occurs unless explicitly requested
blocked_downstream_consumers: full Wizard claim without v4.3 packet and swarm receipts
all-model swarm claim without completed parent/child manifest receipts
source-grounded claim without wiki and repo exact reads
sim promotion or formal admission from a scratch diagnostic

lateral_mappings.label: legacy v4.2 admission validator
preconditions: the receipt labels the schema as legacy validator boundary
full Wizard obligation is checked separately
lateral_mappings.kill_control: if v4.2 schema ok is cited as v4.3 FULL, the claim fails

lateral_mappings.label: model proposal swarm
lateral_mappings.target: bounded proposal and audit receipts from Codex, Gemini TUI, Grok API, OpenRouter Fusion, and top Chinese models
preconditions: each completed child has a receipt path
the runner reruns any adopted candidate through deterministic tools
lateral_mappings.kill_control: remove child receipt paths; the swarm plane must stay partial

lateral_mappings.label: CocoIndex wiki/repo grounding
lateral_mappings.target: semantic retrieval over wiki and repo followed by exact reads
loses: authority unless exact-read evidence is attached
line-level proof unless the source window is named
preconditions: required corpora include wiki and repo
each hit records exact_read true and a real path
lateral_mappings.kill_control: replace exact_read true with retrieval-only; the grounding plane must fail

extended_constraints: CocoIndex wiki and repo retrieval receipts

fixation_breakers: demote any one green plane to partial if the other required planes did not run
separate execution_gates_passed from orchestration_gates_passed before any status wording

loop_contract.repair_rule: repair the first missing receipt plane before adding broader provider fanout
loop_contract.stop_condition: deterministic harness, v4.3 object card, swarm manifest, and grounding receipt are all either passed or explicitly blocked

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question asks for an answer; it is not authorization to implement unless the user explicitly says to do it.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Any route or execution order claim must be checked separately from content correctness, with the order witness named.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: When debugging runtime behavior, preserve the baseline contract fields and debug the execution path underneath.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: A Popper pass names the target claim, strongest live falsifier, decisive check, and killed/open/survived classification before agreement.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: A Feynman pass names the operation, the observable measured, and the pass/fail condition.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must name distinct receipts and explicitly refuse the merge, sequence, or reframe it is not performing.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve with tools before asking; ask the human only for private, preference-bound, or unrecoverable information.

evidence_spine.wizard_runtime: Wizard v4.3 object-preservation guard plus full council topology obligation; v4.2 admission schema is legacy validator compatibility only.

source_math_locks.preserves: sim-mode Max Assembly, parent/child topology truth, model pool separation, and serial controller mutation rules
current Wizard v4.3 route truth and warning that v4.2 is legacy/provenance
separate deterministic, Wizard, swarm, and CocoIndex receipt planes

evidence_spine.claim_ceiling: runner orchestration and evidence-boundary preflight only; no sim promotion, no formal admission, and no full Wizard claim unless all required receipt planes pass
